tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas yan lag bzhi pa'i chog khrigs gsal bar bkod pa bde legs grub pa'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// kun la nyag cig khyab cing bzhugs pa'i sku// 'gyur med ye klong rang bzhin der bzhengs nas// 'pho bcas 'pho med chen por rab gnas pa'i// rdo rje can gyi dpal des skyongs gyur cig /'dir bde mchog bcu gsum ma dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas yan lag bzhi pa'i cho ga khrigs chags su gsal bar 'god pa la/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i rim pa gnyis las sta gon ni/ stegs bu'i khar/ bum pa dgu'am/ rnam rgyal dang*/ las bum gnyis/ rnam rgyal gyi steng rnam rgyal chen po thod pa'am dung chos bkod/ mdun du mchod pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du'ang bdag mchod bshams/ 'og tu dgos pa'i sbyang rdzas sogs yo byad rnams 'du bya/ de nas bstod tshogs ci rigs nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma sogs brgyud 'debs/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa nas/ mya ngan 'das la bkod par skyabs sems so sor lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor nas/ rang la thim par gyur bar gyi rdor sems sgom bzlas song nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ oṃ suṃ bha ni nas/ bskor bar gyur/ snying ga'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed sgrub thabs bzhin song nas/ bum bskyed/ oṃ shū n+ya ta= stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bum pa bzang po nang du pad nyi la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan par gyur bar mngon rtogs skabs nub dang las bum du dum skyes ma dmar mo zhes 'don pa'ang bsgyur/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar/ zhes pa nas/ bum chu dang gnyis med du gyur bar/ rnam rgyal chen po'i chu bum nang du cung zad blug go /de nas suṃ bha ni nyer gcig gis thun la sngags/ rang nyid bde mchog khams gsum rnam rgyal zhal bzhi par gsal ba'i mig g.yas par ma las nyi ma sogs nas/

'bar bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// nas/ gzhan du min/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon bya yi/ gang su yang rung ba zhes nas/ 'gyur ta re/ rten rnams la thun brab/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags kyis bskrad/ zhal bzhi nas khwa gdong ma sogs nas/ bskor bar gyur bar srung 'khor bsgom/ rten gyi mdun du sbyang rdzas/ yungs kar/ chu/ kham phor dkar po/ durba'i snying po dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i chang bu zan chang*/ seng ras dang drug po snod bzhi bzhi bshams/ 'khyil sngags/ oṃ ā bighanan+takritahūm̐dang*/ hūm̐ bdun bdun nas yungs kar la phus 'debs/ yungs kar g.yas dang g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung nas thog mar g.yas pas rten gyi phyogs su g.yon bskor gcig g.yon pas kyang g.yon bskor gcig bya bzhin/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra sa twa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ tshar gnyis brjod/ re re bzhin me nang du dor/ de bzhin du g.yas su bskor te sngags lan gnyis brjod me nang du dor/ de nas chu bzhi yang sngar bzhin bskor nas me nang du blug kham phor bzhi yang sngar bzhin bskor nas gsog snod gcig tu bzhag durba'i snying por bcas pa'i ba lci'i chang bu bzhi dang*/ zan chang bzhi dang*/ seng ras bzhi po yang sngar bzhin sngags dang bcas pas bskor te gsog snod du blug kham phor man chad lag gcig gis bskor/ de dag mer mi bsreg rol mo dang bcas suṃ bha ni brjod cing phyir dor/ nye reg ni las rdor gyis rten gyi mdun phyogs su tsog pur 'dug khyor ba g.yon par chu gtsang blug g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis blangs te sku rten rnams kyi zhal du byab pa'i stangs ka dang*/ snyan gnyis/ spyan gnyis/ shangs dang spyi bo sogs su reg pa'i stangs ka byas/ po ti dang mchod rten sogs la nye reg 'di bya mi dgos zhing*/

sku gzugs la yang mtha' gcig tu mi dgos so// oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ru ka sogs gtso sngags brjod bzhin sku gzugs dngos sam me long gi nang du shar ba'i thugs kar dri bzang gi chus byug yang sngags de zlo bzhin me tog gi 'phreng ba'i me tog rkyang pas dbu la reg yang sngags de rjod bzhin rten gyi mdun du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba nas ting phor du blug te mchod yon phul/ oṃ ā bighanan+ta kri ta hūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas zhing mar me rten gyi phyogs su g.yas su bskor/ hūm̐ bdun gyis spos dkar mar dang sbyar ba spos phor du bsregs te bdug par bya'o// de nas khrus ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su khrus kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal med khang pa yid du 'ong ba shel gyi sa gzhi rin po che'i ka bas brgyan pa/ mu tig dang rin po che sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dngos su bris pa'am mos pa gang rung gi lte bar mañdzi lta bur khrus gzhong dang*/ mtha' skor du 'dag chal/ 'dag chal ni rnam pa lnga te/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ba byung lnga dang*/ dri bzang dang*/ skyu ru ra'i phye ma dang*/ yung ba'i phye ma rnams te/ bdud rtsi lnga/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ ka ra dkar po rnams yin la/ ba byung lnga ni/ ba dmar zal gyi 'o ma/ zho// mar/ lci ba/ chu rnams so// de thams cad 'dzom na rab/ ma 'dzom na ji tsam rnyed pa de tsam gyis chog go gsung*/ dri bzang gi til mar/ sran phye dkar po/ durba 'am ku sha'i pir/ phal khrus kyi chu gtsang blug pa'i bum pa/ sku dbyi'i dar la dri bzang gi ri mo pad 'dab bzhi sngags bcas bkod pa dang*/ me long gos bzang*/ mchog khrus sam gtsang khrus kyi ched du/ bum pa thams cad dam rnam rgyal dang las bum gyi chu bsdus pa'i bum pa khrus chas rnams bshams te/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/

me long sku gzugs 'char ba la 'dag chal gyis byug cing*/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyes pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum dri ma sbyang slad du// chu gtsang 'dag chal sman spos khrus bgyis pas// sems can sgo gsum dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ wak+ka bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ tsit+ta bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ oṃ ma la saṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dri bzang ldan pa'i til mar gyis byug sran phye btab chu gtsang gis bkrus/ yang 'dag chal pir gyis byug zhing*/ rgyal ba'i sku dang nas/ shrī ye hūm̐/ bar gong bzhin lan gsum byas/ des phal khrus sgrub/ de nas mchog khrus sam gtsang khrus ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa dang lha mo rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi bum pa'i chus khrus mdzad/ bkra shis kyi glu dang sna tshogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra la sogs pas mchod par gyur/ rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i chu bsdus pa'i bum pas bkru shing*/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung*// dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// mi ldog pa yis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan sku yi khrus gsol lo// tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan yon tan khrus gsol lo// 'du shes phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan gsung gi khrus gsol lo// 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa// bya ba nan tan ye shes kyi// dpal ldan 'phrin las khrus gsol lo// rnam shes phung po rnam dag cing*// nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi// dpal ldan thugs kyi khrus gsol lo// ji ltar dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan nas// lha mdzes lhums nas bltams tshe khrus gsol ltar// sku gdung ring bsrel dri ma med par bcas// sprul sku yid 'ong rnams la khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta su pra ti shudhe swā hā/

de nas gos gtsang mas/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab sgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.a/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod phyi/ sngar khrus dkyil du gdan drangs pa yin na/ snga ma'i bzhugs sar spos/ min na der rang du/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyi// bdag kyang rdo rje sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye ā hūm̐/ zhes na bza' bzang po phul te bzhag de nas rten bskyed ni/ rten rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ paṃ hūṃ paṃ brtsegs pa rim pa bzhin zhu ba las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du ri rab dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma lhun po'i kha khyab pa'i dkyil du sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ de'i lte bar pad+ma'i sdong po gyen du 'phags pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ ge sar dmar ser/ lte ba mthing ga gri gug gi 'phreng bas mu khyud byas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ yig 'thon de'i lte bar 'khod/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba zhes pa nas yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ nas ko3 haṃ bar/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis rab tu gnas par bya ba sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ nam mkhar gnas pa la/ oṃ ā badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ sogs nyer mchod lngas mchod/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ lan gsum brjod pas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

mgon po 'dir ni byon pa legs/ nas ka me shwa ri kha ga hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ bar mdun bskyed gzhung bzhin byas/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te lag pa g.yon pas dril bu gsil/ g.yas pas spos phul/ lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur par bsam nas// dag pa'i rdo rje bcom ldan 'das// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje 'chang chen bdag gis ni// ji ltar nus pa'i nges spyod kyis// rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor lo sdom// sang ni rab gnas bgyi bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bcom ldan 'das la gus bdag la// rjes su gnang ba mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas rnams ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// gang yang gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha tshogs ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la// dga' dang rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs brtses nye bar bzung nas su// thugs rje ldan rnams rab gnas mdzod// ces snyan gsan phab/ oṃ badz+ra pu ni rā ga ma na ya muḥzhes ye shes pa de nas gshegs te steng gi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ dam tshig pa rten de la/ hūm̐ bhūṃ shrīṃ zhes gos kyis gtums la bzhag go /rten sta gon no// dngos gzhi la/ dkyil 'khor bca' gshoms sogs bkod pa yid du 'ong bar byas nas/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ bdag 'jug len pa/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar/ sgrub mchod kyi cho ga ji lta ba bzhin bzlas pa grub mtshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bdag las gnyis su bye nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la sngar bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ suṃ bha ni lan bdun nam nyer gcig gis thun la 'debs/ a kā ros bgegs la gtor ma bsngos/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan= sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis rten 'di nyid rab tu gnas par bya yis zhes bsgyur nas bgegs skrod srung 'khor byas/

sbyong rdzas/ yungs kar/ chu kham phor durba'i snying po dang bcas pa'i ba lci'i changs bu/ zan chang seng ras sogs rten la g.yon dang g.yas su sngags dang bcas bskor ba nas/ rol mo dang bcas phyir skyel ba tshun sta gon skabs bzhin bya/ de rjes sdig bsreg la/ rten gyi mdun du me long la til gyis sdig gzugs bkod pa bshams la/ rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me/ snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po la/ lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus ste yod pa/ rlung g.yos lte ba'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar bas snying ga'i paṃ de nyid sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par sna sgo nas 'thon mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ mdun du me dang chu/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ me nang du khro bo za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal shin tu gdangs par gyur/ zhes gsal gdab/ oṃ ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bskor zhing til me dang chu gnyis su dor ro// gal te bsdus par dga' na bgegs sbyang sdig sbyang tsam mam byur bsal ba kho na byas pas rung ngo*// de nas btsog khrus dang gtsang khrus sku 'phyi ba'i bar sta gon skabs bzhin te/ rgyal ba'i sku nas/ kā ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ bar ro/ rten bskyed ni/ rten rnams oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang*/ oṃ swa bhā was bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ waṃ laṃ nas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yan mdun bskyed bzhin/ ye shes phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams phyir dengs shig oṃ suṃ bha ni brjod/ sta gon gyi dus nam mkhar bteg pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang gnyis med du gyur par bsam/ mgon po 'dir ni byon pa legs nas/ kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ bar yang mdun bskyed bzhin byas lag g.yon dril bu gsil g.yas pas spos phul te/

lce hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur/ dag pa'i rdo rje bcom ldan 'das// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po thugs rje che bdag nyid// rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor bdag /ji ltar nus pa'i nges spyod kyis// rig pa'i rgyal po he ru kas// 'gro la phan phyir rab gnas bgyi// thams cad 'dir ni rab bzhugs nas// thugs rjes nye bar bzung nas su// thugs rje can rnams rab gnas mdzod// lan gsum/ dzaḥye shes pa rnams dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i steng du bkug hūm̐ de dag la gzhug baṃ gnyis med du bcings/ ho ro gcig tu gyur/ de nas lha dbang bsdus pa/ oṃ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis yon bdag gi rang dang sku gzugs kyi me tog 'phreng ba blangs te gzhung bzhin du mtshon byed kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs par bsam/ 'dis gsang ba'i dal du gzhug ste/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes chen po bskul bas de dag 'od zer gyi rnam pas rten bskyed pa la thim par gyur/ oṃ a be sha s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra rā rā tsa la ya hūm̐ a ha dzhaiḥzhes rol mo dang bcas/ de nas me tog pū tsa hos dor/ gang la phog pa'i lhas/ pra ti gṛ h+ṇa twaṃ i maṃ sa s+t+waṃ ma hā ba la dbur bcings/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ nas/ nai wi d+yaṃ hūm̐ bar gyis nyer mchod lnga phul/ thal sbyar rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang nyid kyi shes rab dang snyoms par zhugs pas snying ga'i 'od kyis rten lhar bskyed pa rnams zhal nas zhugs chags pa chen pos zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar gnas pa la slar sangs rgyas rnams rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs zhu ba'i khu bas rdo rje'i lam nas pad+mar gnas pa de la dbang bskur/

de nas pad+ma las dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i rnam pa snga ma lta bur gyur pa spyi bor 'thon te dkyil 'khor la 'khod par gyur pa la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa dkar po phyag gis bzung*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gar dang glu dang rol mo'i sgra dang me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'i glu len/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas byin gyis brlab pa'i dbu rgyan bskon/ oṃ rat+na aṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ sngags kyis dar dpyangs bcings/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long*// snang mtha'i rdo rje gtad// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa tis+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas don grub kyi dril bu'i/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka lha gang yin der ming btags/ rten rdo rje 'chang rigs thams cad kyi bdag po ye shes kyi phyag rgya la 'khyud par gyur pa la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rig ma dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dkar po phyag gis bzung*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang gar dang glu dang rol mo'i sgra dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pas dbang bskur/ gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig kun gyi bdag nyid=

sems can= de ni deng khyod= ji ltar bltams pa= a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ chu rgyun spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams de la ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du zhugs par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ byin gyis brlab bum dbang ngo*// de nas 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/ rnam snang gi sgo nas zhugs pa bde ba chen po nyams su myong bas byang chub kyi sems su spros pa lha'i zhal du sbyin pa/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes dgyes par gyur/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug des lha mo gtad/ de dang snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du mdzad/ des bag chags sbyangs bas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang du rdzogs par gyur/ dbang gong ma'o// 'di bas rgyas par spro na dbang chog ji lta ba bzhin la bgegs skrod mi dgos/ rang nyid ces pa lta bu'i tshig yod sar rten rnams ces bsgyur ro// de nas mnga' 'bum ni/ gser gyi thur mas dngul gyi kong bur blug pa'i mar sbrang byugs nas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// de bzhin rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan// sems can don du dbye bar bya// oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ bdag cag rnams la thugs rje gzigs pa lhur len pa'i spyan du gyur/ me long bstan/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med// bzung du med ci brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma rigs skye// de nas snyan dbye bar bya ste/ gser gyi rna dru thogs la/ sgra rnams thos pas 'phongs gyur la// rgyal bas chos kyi rnga brdung ltar// de bzhin sems can don gyi phyir// rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bgyi// oṃ de byā kar+ṇa ye swā hā/

shangs dbye ba'i gser gyi rmang tsher thogs te/ zag bcas phung po'i dri spangs pa// rnam par dag pa'i dri brnyes ltar// 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir// rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bgyi// oṃ de byā na sa ye swā hā/ de nas zhal dbye ba'i phyir thur ma thogs ste/ chos kyi chos ro dga' ba ni/ 'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad ltar// ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas 'di// 'bul phyir zhal ni dbye bar bgyi// oṃ de byā mu kha ye swā hā/ so shing 'bul ba/ rin chen mchog grub kā ra wī ra yi// bkur sti rim gros tshems kyi dri bsal ltar// bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub thob gyur nas// 'gro kun skad du chos kyi don ston shog /oṃ de byā dan+ta ye swā hā/ de rnams ni rab byung dang longs sku'i cha byad sogs sku spyi la'o// bye brag longs sku yin na skra shad/ dbu skra lcang lo mthon mthing g.yas 'khyil la// rin chen 'bar bas brgyan pa rab tu mdzes// lha mi kun gyi blta bas mi ngoms pa'i// bsod nams thob phyir rgyal ba'i dbu skra shad// oṃ ke sha bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ rgyan/ bde gshegs sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// byang chub mchog gi rgyan gyis mdzes lags kyang*// rin chen do shal se mo do la sogs// rgyan gyi dam pa mchog rnams mchod par 'bul// oṃ rat+na a laṅka ra hūm̐/ na bza'/ ji ltar sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis// rgyal ba'i sku la na bza' gsol ba ltar// 'gro ba sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir// ngo tsha khrel yod gos mchog 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ de byā ba sa na ya swā hā/ yang rab byung yin na/ ji ltar rang byung mchod rten drung*// ston pas khyim pa'i rtags spangs bzhin// 'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir// de bzhin rgyal ba'i dbu skra bzhar// oṃ sarba shwa dha ni duḥkhats+tshe da hūm̐/ na bza' chos gos gsum/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog

/mkho ba'i yo byad gzhan/ 'gro ba sems can dag la phan pa'i phyir// rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la bslab bya zhes// ji ltar thugs dam rgya cher bzhes pa bzhin// mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ni 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ su kha pa ri ka ri ye swā hā/ oṃ khaṃ su kha pa ri ka ri ye swā hā/ gnyis ka la thugs kar rdo rje bzung*/ mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs bskyed pa'i phyir// dung dang dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil ba dang*// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis rnam brgyan pa// rgyal ba'i thugs la rnam par brgyan par shog /oṃ swasti sha ma hā pu ru ṣa sha na shrī a nu ta ra bi dza na ye swā hā/ de sku gzugs kyi'o// gsung rab po ti la/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badz+ra sa na ā hūm̐/ gos/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra ba// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ glegs shing*/ zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral la// thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i// nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgab bya ba// phul bas skye bos zung 'jug thob par shog /oṃ badz+rā pradz+nyā u pā ya dwā ya āḥhūṃ/ glegs thag spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang*// ye shes chen po ro gcig gyur pa ltar// glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad mchog phul bas// 'gro bas ye shes chen po thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra pusta ka ban+dha ā hūm̐/ yang mchod rten yin na/ srog shing*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos mi nub cing yun ring du gnas par gyur cig

sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig 'khor lo/ oṃ pra wat+ta nā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga dang ldan par gyur cig cod paṇa/ oṃ pa ṭaṃ kā laṃ bā ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod pan dang lhab lhub la sogs pas mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ de dag gi mchod rten dang*/ sku gzugs dang gsung rab la sogs pa de dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig 'phan/ oṃ pa taṃ ke swā hā/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi grags pa dang snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur cig chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan/ oṃ kum+bhi ra dh+wa dza ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi gtong zhing mi 'dzin pas bdud bzhi las rgyal ba'i chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig oṃ bh+ra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal por gyur cig 'phreng ba phul/ oṃ rat+na ma la ye traṃ/ na mas+t+rai ya dhi ka a nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭhi te puṣ+pe ke to be ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ swā hā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te sku blta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra pu na dha ni dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad kyi gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang*/ dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang*/ thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang*/

'gro ba'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba rin po che'i gdan dang*/ chags pa'i skyon thams cad spangs pa pad+ma'i gdan dang*/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig de dag mchod rten gyi'o// sku gsung thugs rten gang la yang thun mong gi mnga' 'bul maṇ+ḍal/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang ste// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa yongs 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ gdugs sogs/ theg mchog bla bre gdugs dang ba dan dang*// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dar 'phan dang*// gar dang rol mo'i mchod pa sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mdzes par bgyi// rin chen bdun/ ji ltar mi dbang 'khor lo bsgyur ba ni// rin chen sna bdun tshogs dang ldan pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyis// bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyis// 'dod yon lnga/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// mchog tu gyur pa'i longs spyod rnams// bdag gis dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra de wi an sa ma dhi swā hā/ bil ba sogs/ 'jig rten khyim bdag rnams ni dpal bsten nas// bil ba star ka bum pa bzang po ras// mdun du bdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// mchod bstod kyi mnga' 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ prokak+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa ma ṇaṃ sngon du 'gro bas/

phyi mchod/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed sogs dang*/ nang mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'dod 'byung sogs/ gsang mchod/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs// de kho na nyid/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor sogs dang*/ bstod pa bcom ldan mgon po nas// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bar te/ mchod bzhi bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs bstun bya/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pas/ rgyas bsdus gang rung lag len dag par bya zhing*/ 'on kyang spyir bsdus pa'i skabs dang gal te ma grub kyang 'gal ba cher med par sems/ sbyin sreg 'jug de'i me ma shi ba'i thog tu lcags sgyed btsugs steng snod gtsang ma phyi rtsi dkar gyis byugs pa'i nang du 'o ma la mar sbrang bur ka ra dang*/ 'bras cung zad btab pa kha bkab pa'i snod la me tog gi 'phreng ba btags/ de'i sne nas slob dpon gyis bzung ste/ rang gi bdag po'i sngags zhes pa g.yang skyong gi sngags/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ya pad+ma te bid+ya rā dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskol/ rten gyi gzugs brnyan me long la shar du bcug pa'i zhal du blugs gzar ram sgron skyogs lta bus/ oṃ de byā an+ne sa mā dhi dh+ya na pri ṇa ne swā hā/ lan nyer gcig tsam gyis phul bas lha rnams kyis gsol bar bsam/ de nas/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes pas dam tshig bsgrag lhag ma tshogs pa dang yon bdag la bkye/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sogs bsangs sbyangs nas/ tshogs mchod dang*/ 'das gtor 'jig rten pa'i nang gtor mjug dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod bar song rjes/ rten bsgyur ni/ mdun gyi rten dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs su gsal ba 'od du zhu ba las rten rang rang gi rnam par gyur zhes brjod cing*/ rab tu gnas bya'i lha so so'i skyed chog byas pa yin na gong smos ma thag pa 'di zer mi dgos/

de nas lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rje btsun pa dang dkon mchog rin po che thams cad dang*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa dpon slob rnams kyis rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten 'di rnams 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi phyag gi gnas mchod pa'i rten du gyur nas sprul pa sku'i mdzad pa mngon sum du mdzad par gyur cig gsum ka sku gsung thugs 'gro ba'i don la 'khor ba ji srid du gnas par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab par gyur/ de nas slob dpon dang yon bdag gnyis kas rten gyi gdan khri nas bzung me tog gi 'phreng ba phul/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni// rlung gis bskal pas 'jig par du// sbyin bdag bsod nams spel ba dang*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// dga' ldan gnas su rab zhugs nas// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums bzhugs ltar// de ltar 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// byang chub sems ni yongs 'phel phyir// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes te// mgon po 'dir ni rtag bzhugs mdzod// 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla zhing sku gzugs la sogs pa'i 'og bar steng gi char rdo rje gsor/ lan gsum bskor/ de rjes bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje dbyings khyod phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dpa' ba che// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston mdzad rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// rin chen rgyal po shin tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med// rdo rje sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje bdud rtsi rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin// sa dang pha rol phyin pa brnyes// rdo rje'i gsung khyod phyag 'tshal lo// don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs can// dag pa'i ngo bo nyid las byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal// ye dharma legs par sngags pa'i 'bru 'thor zhing*/

shis brjod rmad du byung ba 'di bya ste/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// des ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// bkra shis dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de yi nye bar bstan ba'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// bkra shis dam pa= dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// bkra shis dam pa= sems can kun la phan phyir byang chub mnga' ba po// don rnams thams cad grub par brtul ba yongs ldan pa// tshogs kyi legs skyes thub pa'i bkra shis gang byung ba// bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i// gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te// dbang bcas lhas bskor ba yi bkra shis gang byung ba// bkra shis des= lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lum+bi'i tshal// lha mang dag gis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na// srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shis gang byung ba// bkra shis des= grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du// lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshegs zas gtsang sras// myur bskrun bdud rtsi chus gtor ba yi bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des= grong khyer dam pa ser skya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni// rmad du grags pa chen por lha yis mngon bstod pa// bsam yas bde sgrub bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des=

dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste// dka' thub tshal du mngon par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs// lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des= rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i sku mnga' zhing*// baiḍūr+ya ltar sngo ba'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te// skyil mo krung bcas mi g.yo mchog gi bkra shis gang*/ bkra shis des= chu bo'i 'gram na tsi rka'i 'phreng bas yongs bskor ba// shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa// klu yi rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des= shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs// mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nam mkha' la// bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tshogs gang byung ba// bkra shis= sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje gdan bzhugs te// nam gyi tho rangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba// ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis= grong khyer wā rā ṇa sīr drang srong mchog bzhugs nas// chos kyi 'khor lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang*// lha yul dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur ba// bkra shis= bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa dag byed pa// bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa// bcom ldan shākya thub pa seng ge'i gang gsung pa// bkra shis= mu stegs byed pa kun gyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang*// 'gro la bde ba bskyed phyir cho 'phrul dam pa dag /nye bar ston pa rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa// bkra shis= 'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te// tshangs pa la sogs lha tshogs lag na rnga yab gdugs// sna tshogs thogs pas yongs su bskor bas bkra shis gang*// bkra shis= de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i mchog tu nyer gshegs pa// man+dhar yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod pa// lha mchog rnams kyis mngon bstod pa yi bkra shis gang*// bkra shis=

lha dbang klu dang mi yi dbang pos phyag byas pa// mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang pos mchod gyur pa// de bzhin gshegs pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni= zhi byed shog /ces pa'am/ yang na sngags lugs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma yi dam gyi shis brjod sogs gang rung skabs dang 'brel ba brjod par bya'o// rol mo rgyas par bya/ chos skyong bsgo ba srung ma'i gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas pa'i mjug snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis bye brag gi sa'i bdag po 'khor bcas ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis bsngos nas/ 'gro ba sems can don slad du// bde gshegs rnams ni bzhugs gyur gyi// bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir// sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan bsrung bar mdzod// yang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ.oṃbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pas ji srid bcom ldan 'das bzhugs kyi bar du bsrung bar mdzad du gsol// de nas yon bdag la bsgo te slob dpon gyi mdun du bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyi tsakli sogs bshams/ yon bdag rten la phyag 'tshal du bcug gdan bzang po la bzhag nas/ slob dpon gyis/ rab gnas kyi gzhung las/ khyod kyi nga la gang gsol ba'i// sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du// ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du// de dag don ni ngas byas te// de rnams don ni grub zin gyi// ci bde bar ni mchod par bgyis// zhes yon bdag la bsgo bar gsungs pa ltar// rten 'di nyid la rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad rgyan du mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor pas mchod pa dang*/ khyad par zhag bdun gyi bar du mchod pa rgya cher mdzod cig

de nas mtha' rten bkra shis pa'i don du bkra shis kyi rdzas gtod pa phyag len du mchis pas de la thog mar/ yon gyi bdag po nyid lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gsal gdab dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ las bum gyis chus bsangs/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he= swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yon gyi bdag po nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ gtso bo'i snying gar oṃ ha nas phaṭ phaṭ snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas rdzas rnams la las bum gyi chu 'thor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sel zhing bde legs phun sum tshogs pa byed pa'i nus mthu can gyi grub pa'i rdzas su gyur/ rdzas brgyad re re bzhin lag tu thogs te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs pa ltar/ deng 'dir yang rten 'di nyid bkra shis shing byin che bas 'khor ba ji srid du 'gro ba'i don khyad par can 'grub pa dang*/ yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag zhi zhing srid zhi'i dpal 'byor la mnga' mdzad pa'i slad du/ me long gi rdzas phul ba la brten nas/ zhes pa'i mtshams su 'dus pa dmangs mas mthun 'gyur gyi tshul du blangs te dpon slob lhan cig pas/ bkra shis par gyur cig ces me tog 'thor zhing*/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho nas/ bgegs rnams zhi bar shog bar/ rdzas kyi tsakli dang por rten la 'bul tshul dang*/

rjes su yon bdag gi mdun lcog rtse'i khar 'bru dkar gyis gang ba'i snod du g.yas bskor gyis sgrigs te bzhag de bzhin gzugs kyi lha mo'i tshab tu/ gnyis 'thung dbang po sa srung gi gi'u waṃ phyag tu phul ba zhes dang*/ khyim bdag bzang skyong gis zho/ bram ze kun dha lis rtsa durba/ nags tshal gyi lha mos shing thog bil ba/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar g.yas 'khyil/ sa'i lha mo brtan mas li khri/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar phul ba sogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs kun 'gre'o// rgyal srid sna bdun yod cing spro na/ dzam+bu'i gser las sogs la 'khor lo rin chen dam pas shis gyur cig ces bsgyur te gtod/ de nas tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag gtor btang ba sogs rjes chog rnams bde mchog dkyil chog gzhung bzhin bya'o// de ltar rab gnas kyi cho ga yan lag bzhi pa bde mchog bcu gsum ma dang sbyar ba'i chog khrigs gsal ba 'di bzhin rigs kyi gcung mi pham bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi yang yang dgos zhes smra ba'i ngor/ rang gzhan mang por phan pa'i slad du/ 7bka' brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'gyur med yongs grub dam chos nyi mas lhas bstan gsang sngags chos kyi gling du sbyar ba bde legs su gyur cig// /
